ctx.x: Erroll Garner. Oh, you had Dodo Mamarosa, you had all these guys that were playing with the small bands that -- the right hand was coming into common. The left hand

was exactly like the bass drummer's right foot, you know. Went from bass drums to no bass drums. Went from left hand to no left hand. Just that quick. It went from holding one note to making a whole lot of notes on your horn, you know. And it went from making a simple chord to putting a flatted fifth or 13th or suspended note or whatever. It went from the basics to -- of music, to something that people were looking for something. They were trying everything. It was an experimental age in music, I think, because…
